sentences.text: Let me walk you through how this system evolved.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: We started with a system called 'MaintIE'
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: which stands for Maintenance Information Extraction.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: The first version had a major limitation:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: it could only work with maintenance reports.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: Why?
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: Because it used a fixed schema with almost 4,000 lines of predefined rules.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: This created a problem:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: whenever we wanted to process a different type of document,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: we would need to write completely new rules.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: The system was too specific and couldn't adapt.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - How It Started - Phase 1 (July 12-15, 2025)

sentences.text: We quickly realized
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: we needed a more flexible solution.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: Our goal was to process any type of document,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: not just maintenance data.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: So what did we do?
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: We replaced the fixed rules
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: with dynamic templates.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: These templates could automatically adjust
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: based on the content they encountered.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: This was our solution for adaptability.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: Surprisingly,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: this major improvement happened very quickly
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: just a few days of work
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: between July 16th and 19th.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: The business impact was immediate:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: our system could now handle any document type.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: Why am I telling you this?
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: Because it's directly relevant to your research mapping project.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: Your system will need to process many different formats
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: research papers, grant applications, clinical protocols
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: and this flexible approach would work perfectly for that challenge.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Getting Better - Phase 2 (July 16-19, 2025)

sentences.text: As our system grew more capable,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: we encountered a new problem.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: One single process trying to do everything
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: was becoming inefficient and hard to improve.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: We needed a new architecture.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: The solution?
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: We split the system into three specialized agents
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: The first agent analyzes content structure
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: like understanding what type of document it is
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: The second agent finds entities and their relationships
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: like identifying researchers and their projects
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: The third agent handles complex searches
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: like answering questions about connections
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: Think of it like this:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: instead of having one person trying to do everything,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: we created a team of specialists
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: where each member focuses on what they do best.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: How does this apply to your project?
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: Your research mapping tool will need to perform similar tasks:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: extract researcher information,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: map project connections,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: and answer complex questions.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: This multi-agent approach would give you better results
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: in each of those areas.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Multi-Agent Design - Phase 3 (August 7-8, 2025)

sentences.text: The next challenge we faced was about search capability.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: We made an important discovery:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: simple keyword search wasn't enough
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: to find complex relationships in our data.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: Let me explain the problem:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: When users asked questions like "Show me all related components and their failures,"
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: keyword search would miss many important connections.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: Why?
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: Because relationships exist beyond just matching words.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: To solve this,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: we developed what we called "tri-modal search"
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: combining three different approaches
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: First, vector search
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: which finds similar content
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: even when words don't match exactly
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: Second, graph search
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: which follows direct relationships
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: like "researcher works on project"
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: Third, neural network search
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: which discovers hidden patterns
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: across the entire database
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: The result was remarkable.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: This combined approach could answer complex questions
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: that none of the individual methods could handle alone.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: For your research mapping project,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: this approach would be extremely valuable.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: You'll need to find many types of connections
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: between researchers, projects, and themes
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: some obvious and direct,
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: others more subtle and indirect.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: This tri-modal approach would capture all of these relationships.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

sentences.text: The final challenge we addressed was practicality.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: A system with great features isn't useful

sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: it required over 30 manual steps

sentences.text: to process a batch of documents.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: This created two issues:

sentences.text: First, it was very time-consuming, taking hours.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: Second, it was prone to human error.
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: Our solution was automation.

sentences.text: Analysis
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: Entity extraction
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: Relationship mapping
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: Search preparation
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: The impact was dramatic:
sentences.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Automation - Phase 5 (August 15-21, 2025)

sentences.text: processing time dropped from hours to just 15 minutes.

vocabulary.text: We made an important discovery:
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: simple keyword search wasn't enough

vocabulary.text: to find complex relationships in our data.
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: Let me explain the problem:
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: When users asked questions like "Show me all related components and their failures,"

vocabulary.text: keyword search would miss many important connections.
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: Why?
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: Because relationships exist beyond just matching words.
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: To solve this,
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: we developed what we called "tri-modal search"
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: combining three different approaches
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: First, vector search
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: which finds similar content

vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: Second, graph search
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: which follows direct relationships
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: like "researcher works on project"
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: Third, neural network search
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: which discovers hidden patterns
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: across the entire database
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: The result was remarkable.
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: This combined approach could answer complex questions
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: that none of the individual methods could handle alone.
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: For your research mapping project,
vocabulary.category: 3. The Azure Universal RAG Project - Better Search - Phase 4 (August 14-20, 2025)

vocabulary.text: this approach would be extremely valuable.
